description: M.I. Avvaumma v. M.I. Ahamed Lebbe M.I. Avvaumma v. M.I. Ahamed Lebbe View More before Hon. A.W. Abdus Salam, J.
parties: M.I. Avvaumma v. M.I. Ahamed Lebbe M.I. Avvaumma v. M.I. Ahamed Lebbe View More
keywords: Plaintiff claimed the right to draw water from a common well (aquae haustus) under deed. District Court found the Plaintiff had abandoned this servitude, as neither she nor her tenants had ever exercised it. Held - Application dismissed with costs after affirming that abandonment of servitude, whether express or tacit, destroys it, and that where a principal servitude is abandoned, any accessory servitude is also deemed abandoned.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
